verdict.rationale: Rollbar ships an official, first-party MCP server that AI tools like Claude and Cursor run directly, so users can operate Rollbar through natural-language prompts in those clients. The Resolve AI agent turns a production error into a reviewable pull request, but that is an automated fix workflow, not a natural-language command interface. Missing for 10: a native in-product natural-language command interface, documentation of which operations the MCP server exposes (read-only vs. actions like resolve/assign), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: This MCP server implements the `stdio` server type, which means your AI tool (e.g. Claude, Cursor) will run it directly
Resolve is an AI agent in Rollbar that takes a production error and produces a pull request you can review.
